en.history.title: History
en.history.sub: Last 10 configurations — stored only in your browser
en.history.emptyHint: Configurations are saved here automatically after you generate a QR code
en.history.tip1: Click Apply to load a configuration back into the generator
en.history.tip2: History is stored locally and can be cleared at any time
en.history.tip3: Keeps the 10 most recent records, newest first
